q: What goes into the CBAM figure for DAP from Gabès?
title: Gabès DAP: the CBAM figure
short: DAP contains nitrogen, so it is a CBAM good. Its figure adds the ammonia it contains, usually imported for Tunisian plants, to the plant's fuel, steam and power. Triple superphosphate made at the same sites carries no nitrogen and sits outside CBAM.
audience: EU importers of Tunisian fertilisers and traders buying DAP from Gabès and Skhira

ul: Ammonia precursor, from the supplier's verified figure or defaults.
Electricity, since indirect emissions count for fertilisers.

p: Tunisia has no carbon price that an importer could deduct.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
